# Essor

> Essor is a French-language school and training-center management platform by Eiden Group,
> built for private paramedical schools in Morocco. It brings student records and enrollment,
> timetabling, monthly payments and reminders, exams, report cards, and clinical-placement
> tracking into a single web app. Tagline: "Zéro Excel, zéro chaos."

## What Essor does

- **Étudiants / enrollment**: student files, enrollment by filière (Infirmier polyvalent, Prothèse dentaire, Kinésithérapie, Sage-femme…) and semester.
- **Planning**: weekly timetable, session scheduling, room and trainer assignment, double-booking prevention.
- **Paiements**: per-student monthly installments, automatic late/unpaid flags, receipts (PDF), email reminders, real-time outstanding-balance view for the director.
- **Examens & bulletins**: exam planning, grade entry, weighted averages, report cards and transcripts with a decision (Admis / Rattrapage / Ajourné).
- **Stages cliniques**: assignment of students to host structures (hospitals, clinics), capacity tracking per service, generation and signature of internship agreements (conventions).
- **Rôles**: separate accounts for direction, affaires estudiantines, and formateurs.

## Who it is for

Directors of private health-training schools, student-affairs managers, and trainers. Works for a single center or a multi-campus network.

## Pricing

- **Essentiel** — from 1,000 MAD HT / month, single administrator.
- **Pro** — from 2,000 MAD HT / month, multi-role team, payments, report cards, placements.
- **Réseau** — custom quote, multi-campus.
- Price scales per 100-student tier. Annual billing gives 2 months free. No setup or hidden fees; onboarding, training, updates and support included. No lock-in (monthly plans have no commitment).

## Key facts

- Language: French only. Interface adapted to the Moroccan context.
- Hosting: European infrastructure; encrypted in transit and at rest; data isolated per school.
- Data portability: export students, payments, grades and report cards to Excel/PDF at any time.
- Setup: nothing to install (runs in the browser); importing a multi-hundred-student roster from Excel takes about a morning.
- Demo: 20-minute guided demo on the school's own data, requested via the pricing → contact form.
